title: Exact-palette rainbow embeddings in uniformly coloured pseudorandom graphs
summary: We study rainbow spanning configurations in bijumbled graphs whose edges are coloured independently and uniformly from a prescribed palette. For $n$-vertex $(p,β)$-bijumbled graphs with minimum degree at least a fixed positive multiple of $pn$, we obtain rainbow perfect matchings and Hamilton cycles with a sufficient palette surplus of order $(\log n)/p$, assuming $pn=ω(\log n)$ and $β\le cpn$ for a sufficiently small constant $c$.
